landing.heroTitleStart: A Digital Bridge Between Farmers and
landing.heroBody: KrushiSetu connects farmers, procurement centres, transport and agricultural services through one intelligent digital platform — from AI crop advice to RFID-verified digital weighing and same-day settlement.
landing.overviewHeading: One platform. The entire procurement journey.
landing.overviewBody: Most tools solve one fragment — a weighing slip here, a scheme portal there. KrushiSetu links the whole chain: farmer registration, crop intelligence, live centre capacity, slot booking, RFID truck identification, digital weighment, CV produce verification and settlement — all under one transaction identity.
landing.bullet1: Farmer, truck, weight and produce bound to a single transaction ID
landing.bullet2: Capacity-checked slot booking — no more wasted trips
landing.bullet3: Every weighment backed by a tamper-evident audit trail
landing.howHeading: From farm gate to payment, in six connected steps
landing.step1Body: Digital farmer ID with land, crop and bank details — verified once, valid across every centre.
landing.step2Body: Live map of centres with real capacity, queue and predicted waiting time before travelling.
landing.step3Body: Vehicle automatically matched to farmer, booking and produce at the entry gate.
landing.step4Body: Weighbridge captures gross, tare and net weight directly into the transaction — no manual logs.
landing.step5Body: Computer vision confirms the expected crop and flags mismatches before settlement.
landing.step6Body: Every step is traceable end-to-end, protecting farmers and the procurement system.
landing.benefitsBody: Large readable interfaces, nine Indian languages, mobile-first navigation and an AI assistant that answers in your own words. Everything a farmer needs before the truck even leaves the village.
landing.benefit1Body: See capacity, queue and waiting time before you travel.
landing.benefit2Body: Personalised eligibility across PM-KISAN, PMFBY, KCC and more.
landing.benefit3Body: Ask questions in 9 Indian languages, any time.
landing.benefit4Body: Weather, MSP and crop advisories tuned to your district.
landing.smartHeading: A control room for every procurement centre
landing.smartBody: Operators see live weighments, truck queues, lane assignments and verification alerts in one operational dashboard — with automated lane assignment and computer-vision produce verification working alongside them.
landing.transparencyBody: Every stage of procurement is digitally verified and linked. If a weight, produce or identity doesn't match, the transaction is flagged before payment — protecting honest farmers and public grain stocks alike.
landing.aiBody: Krushi AI analyses crop photos, predicts centre waiting times, explains government schemes and answers questions across nine Indian languages — bringing expert-level guidance to every farmer with a phone.
landing.statsDisclaimer: Prototype figures for demonstration — not official statistics.
landing.ctaHeading: Ready to see transparent procurement in action?
landing.ctaBody: Sign in with a demo OTP and step into the farmer journey or the centre control room.
